combo_label: The Village Fete × Herbs & Spices × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Iced and filled sponge on the home baking stall, sold by the slice or whole
Dried Mediterranean leaf scattered over a pizza before it goes in the oven
Smallest tier of local government in England, and the district one church serves
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Stubby stone club, its rounded end worked in circles to crush whole seeds
Narrow leaf tasting of aniseed, whisked into a bearnaise sauce for steak
Lead brass instrument of a British band, shorter and mellower than a trumpet
Dark igneous rock of the Whin Sill, its spotted kind hauled to Wiltshire
Seed case of a climbing orchid, cured until black and split to scent custard
Feathery frond laid over cured salmon, and the flavour in a jar of gherkins
Smaller inner pillar of Welsh rock, named for the tint it shows when wet
